admission.sentence: Admission: 1219 reaction candidates, 555 admitted to the trade band and the chart reads (548 by the 4% scan, 7 by the dollar scan on a range-expansion, higher-volume day); 664 came through the dollar scan alone without one and are research only. Of the 118 mechanical A-band names without a veto, 35 are admitted and 83 are not. Admission is read off the recorded discovery route and the checklist's own range-expansion and volume checks; it is never a grade, and the chart reader never sees a name it stops.

registry.coverage_note: A bounded manual registry of known cash-acquisition events, not a live news feed, exhaustive corporate-action screen, or clearance of unlisted stocks. Each event records its own source dates and manual review date. Unresolved events stay excluded after review_due and require a new source review; expected closing dates and go-shop deadlines never automatically clear a stock.
